annotations.title: Look Up Error in Project Memory

description: Check whether this project has seen an error before, instantly and for free: no model call, not counted against the debug limit. Returns how often it was seen, the fix that was confirmed for it (or one that stopped holding, so you do not repeat it), and fixes recently reported as failed in this project. Call it first on any failure, trivial ones included. With a confirmed fix, apply it and re-run what failed; otherwise call debug_error for a full analysis.

errorText.description: The error message or stack trace, as you would pass it to debug_error.

filePath.description: An ABSOLUTE path inside the repository the error came from, if you have one.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the repository this error came from, when you were started somewhere else. Memory is scoped to it.

name: lookup_error
title: Look Up Error in Project Memory
